message.content: {"mechanism_id":"per-dimension-F-floor-with-memory-reset","target_component":"mutation scale factor F and memory M_F","observed_evidence":{"task_id":"TASK-05","trace_path":"diagnostic_trace_summary","function":"F11","seed":11,"metric":"F_mean_late","observed_value":0.08},"causal_hypothesis":"Lehmer-mean memory collapses M_F toward tiny values when early successful deltas are small, so seeds 22/33 lose mutation step size and diversity hits 0; seed 11 escapes because its early F draws stay larger.","algorithmic_change":"Add a per-dimension lower bound on sampled F tied to current population spread, and reset M_F to 0.5 when measured diversity falls below a threshold for a window of generations.","mathematical_rule":"F_i = max(F_sample_i, F_min + (F_max - F_min) * (diversity / diversity_0)); if diversity < tau for W gens then M_F[k] = 0.5 for all k; diversity = mean pairwise distance / (ub - lb).","expected_effect":"Prevents F collapse on seeds 22/33, keeping nonzero diversity longer and reducing final-fitness variance across seeds 11/22/33 on F11.","failure_prediction":"On unimodal or easy functions the F floor slows convergence and may worsen mean fitness; if tau is too high, resets fire constantly and disable memory adaptation.","ablation_plan":"Compare (a) full mechanism, (b) F floor only, (c) memory reset only, (d) baseline, over seeds 11/22/33 on F11 and F1/F5; report diversity, stall, and final fitness variance.","nearest_known_methods":"JADE/SHADE memory adaptation, F lower-bound clamping, diversity-triggered restart (excluded), success-history adaptation.","implementation_requirements":"Track population diversity each generation; store diversity_0 from generation 0; add tau and W parameters; modify F sampling and M_F update in lshade_canonical.py."}
